newsitem.title: UK: Eve wins 22 mln stg contract.
newsitem.headline: Eve wins 22 mln stg contract.

text.p: British civil engineering firm Eve Group Plc said on Thursday its utility contracting unit Eve Claydon was awarded a 22 million stg contract by Energy Group Plc's Eastern Electricity.

The contract, awarded since the year end, is for providing utility based services to Eastern. Initially running for two years, there is an option for a further two years which could result in the contract reaching a value of 50 million stg.

The group also reported a return to the black with pre-tax profits of 1.5 million stg for the year to March 31, compared with a loss of 4.6 million the year before. It proposed a total dividend of 4.5 pence a share, up from 1.0 pence a year ago.

"Eve's businesses now represent an excellent balance of engineering expertise across the power and construction industries and our aim is to consolidate and develop these skills," chairman Bill Kerss said in the results statement.
The AIM-listed group, which plans a full listing on the London Stock Exchange later this year, also announced the appointment of Chris Wigg as finance director.
Its share price was up 5.0 pence at 175 pence at 0745 GMT.
